questions.question: The price of a phone is increased by 20% and then the new price is decreased by 20%. What is the net change in price?
questions.solution: Net change = a + b + ab/100 = 20 − 20 − (20×20)/100 = −4%. So a 4% decrease.

A right triangle has legs 6 cm and 8 cm. What is the area of its circumcircle?
questions.solution: Hypotenuse = √(36+64) = 10 cm. In a right triangle the hypotenuse is the circumdiameter, so r = 5 cm and area = 25π cm².

A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, how long will they take?
questions.solution: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36 per day. Time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

A car goes from A to B at 60 km/h and returns at 40 km/h. What is its average speed for the round trip?
questions.solution: For equal distances, average speed = 2xy/(x+y) = 2×60×40/100 = 48 km/h.

questions.question:
Statements: All cats are dogs. All dogs are birds.
Conclusions: I. All cats are birds. II. Some birds are cats.
questions.solution: Cats ⊂ Dogs ⊂ Birds, so all cats are birds (I). Since all cats are birds, some birds are cats (II, conversion of I). Both follow.

questions.question:
Statements: Some pens are books. No book is a pencil.
Conclusions: I. Some pens are not pencils. II. No pen is a pencil.
questions.solution: The pens that are books cannot be pencils, so some pens are not pencils (I). Pens that aren't books may or may not be pencils, so II doesn't necessarily follow.

questions.question: If CAT is coded as DBU, how is DOG coded?
questions.solution: Each letter is shifted +1: C→D, A→B, T→U. So D→E, O→P, G→H = EPH.

questions.question: In a code, APPLE = 50 (sum of the alphabet positions of its letters). What is GRAPE?
Pointing to a man, Riya says, "He is the son of my father's father's only son." How is the man related to Riya?
questions.solution: Father's father's only son = Riya's father. The son of Riya's father is her brother.

questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. How is A related to D?
questions.solution: A and B are C's children. D is C's father, so D is A's grandfather. A is female (sister), so A is D's granddaughter.

Ravi walks 5 km north, turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 9 km. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.solution: Right of north is east: he ends 3 km east and 5 − 9 = 4 km south of the start. Distance = √(3² + 4²) = 5 km.

questions.question: P, Q, R, S and T sit in a row facing north. S is in the middle. R is at one of the extreme ends. T sits second from the left. Q sits immediately to the right of P. Who sits at the extreme right?
questions.solution: Positions 1–5 from left: S = 3, T = 2. P–Q need two adjacent free seats: only 4–5 (since 1–2 has T). So P = 4, Q = 5, R = 1. Order: R T S P Q. Q is at the extreme right.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 8, 27, 64, 100, 125
questions.solution: 8, 27, 64, 125 are perfect cubes (2³, 3³, 4³, 5³). 100 is not a cube.

A, B, C and D sit around a square table, one on each side, all facing the centre. A sits opposite C, and B is on A's immediate left. Who is on A's immediate right?
questions.solution: With A opposite C, A's two neighbours are B and D. B is on A's left, so D is on A's right.
